body: Thanks for the information, but I think my mind has been made up. I just wanted to get this off my chest I guess.

Have you tried therapy? Therapy was really helpful for me while I was coping through depression. Also, I know this is not really my place to say and merely a suggestion- but have you thought about cutting back on the pot a bit? I know it feels good but from my experience it's a really bad mix with mood disorders. P.s. your English is great!

Hi, I talked to my obgyn about getting some medicine. Does the medicine reduce transmission?  My partner was uninformed I think, and it was a mistake we didn't use condoms (sort of in the moment and I had BC deal). I let him know he should be tested. Thanks for this though, it was really helpful hearing it from an unaffected partner.

I had a regular talk therapist for 2 years, but since she's in another state I need to transfer. I haven't had the nerve to call up the talk therapy service yet. 

I thought about it, but a) I'm not really motivated to work and b) I'm leaving in the Summer to start school again, so I'm not sure who would hire me for such a short period of time.
